{{Quote|This is Unit 6 in Barracks D4. We have severe structural damage here.|A stormtrooper of Unit 6|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Unit 6''' was the designation of at least one of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed at [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The designation was in use by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as part of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="TFUII" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> Unit 6 tried to stop [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], an [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] late [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]], from escaping the planet.<ref name="TFUII" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II}}
The unit fought against Starkiller near [[Barracks D4]], and one [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] reported that the barracks suffered severe structural damage.<ref name="TFUII" />
{{Endgame}}

Ultimately, the clone managed to escape.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unit 6 first appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released in [[2010]]. The game does not specify whether it is a single trooper or a [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. During each playthrough, the quote is randomized, meaning the stormtrooper reports the damage varies each time, and Unit 6 may or may not mention the barracks.<ref name="TFUII" />
